extras: The plugin requires a free Google Cloud OAuth client setup and uses specific Google APIs for sign-in and file storage.
problem: Users need a way to sync their Obsidian vault across multiple devices using cloud storage without exposing their note content to the cloud provider.

relations.evidence: If you already use an rclone crypt remote on Google Drive, the plugin can share it.

summary: End-to-end encrypted vault synchronization tool that uses Google Drive and rclone crypt compatibility for secure cross-device syncing.
